name: Recky's Tiger Teen Camp
description_short: Six week borough teen camp at the Tenafly Teen Center for grades 6 to 10, with sports, games, pool time, special events and optional paid field trips.
refund_policy_summary: Refunds before May 22 carry a $20 processing fee; no refunds after May 22, and trip fees are never refunded.
notes: Price is the non-resident fee; residents pay $750. Pool membership plus teen camp bundle saved $150 through March 16. A $75 late fee applied after March 17. 9 am to 3 pm, no camp Friday July 3. 2026 trips cost $55 to $120 each.
